shots.title: Episode 001 presenter overlay
shots.instruction: Record a clean head-and-shoulders take for the recurring lower-right circular presenter overlay. Look into the lens, keep the background uncluttered, and leave enough margin for a circular crop.
shots.script: 我本地已经有一套 Skills，但 Web ChatGPT 不会自己扫描它们。所以我给它补了一层很小的 bootstrap：先动态发现，再只加载匹配的 Skill。真正有用的是，加载以后它还能通过 MacDevBridge 把任务落到我的 Mac 上。

notes.usage: lower-right circular presenter overlay; may be cut into hook, tradeoff, and payoff beats
